one_line_summary: A high-rise, Nulu-fabric, buttery-soft legging engineered for yoga that became the dominant 'I'm running errands' pant of the late 2010s and still hasn't yielded.
energy: off-duty competence — the legging of someone who has a Pilates membership and a green smoothie habit
pull_quote: Buy if you actually move in them (yoga, walks, errands) and you've never owned a pair. Pass if you already own activewear and want fashion-forward — these are uniform, not statement.

verdicts.label: soft / practical / off-duty
verdicts.reasoning: These are the legging benchmark for a reason. The Nulu fabric has the right ratio of buttery-soft and compressive — you forget you're wearing them within an hour. The 25" inseam hits at the right spot for most heights. Buy one black pair, wear them three times a week.

verdicts.label: technical / high-impact
verdicts.reasoning: Align fabric is too soft for serious running, lifting, or anything with bounce — they don't hold you in. You want the Lululemon Fast & Free or the Wunder Train instead. Align is for yoga and low-impact movement, despite what its marketing implies.

verdicts.label: current / styled-out / trend-aware
verdicts.reasoning: The Align is the safest, most-saturated legging in the category. Wearing them now reads more 'mom' than 'editor.' If you want activewear that signals taste, look at Beyond Yoga Spacedye or Alo's Airbrush — same fabric quality, less ubiquitous. Or commit fully to a SET legging.

verdicts.label: delicate / scaled / shorter-inseam
verdicts.reasoning: The 25" inseam was designed for you. The 28" hits weird on shorter heights. Go down a size from your usual — Align stretches significantly after the first wear. If you're under 5'2", try the 23" inseam first.

why_people_love_it: The Nulu fabric is the only legging material most wearers can't feel against their skin after putting them on — that's the entire pitch and it's real
The four-way stretch and rise mean they actually stay up during movement, unlike most leggings under $100
Massive color and inseam variety; restocks are reliable enough that your 'size + color' will come back if currently sold out
where_it_falls_flat: Pilling on the inner thigh starts around month 4 of regular wear — Lululemon's quality guarantee will replace, but you have to push for it
The Nulu fabric is sheer in lighter colors during deep squats — black, navy, or dark wine are the only sensible workout choices
Resale is so saturated that selling used pairs nets you almost nothing; treat the $128 as fully consumed

alternatives.name: CRZ Yoga Naked Feeling Legging
alternatives.reasoning: Quarter the price, ~85% of the feel. Amazon's best-rated Align dupe with 100k+ reviews. Won't last as long but at the price point you can replace 3x before matching one Align cost.

alternatives.name: Lululemon Wunder Train Legging
alternatives.reasoning: Same brand, different fabric. Holds you in during running, lifting, HIIT. The right pick if 'workout legging' is the actual use case.

alternatives.name: Beyond Yoga Spacedye Caught in the Midi Legging
alternatives.reasoning: Same softness, more interesting color palette (heathers, dusty pastels), $30 cheaper. The activewear of people who don't want to be wearing Lululemon.
